artworks.title: Choir of a Spanish Church
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior with various figures and objects. The drawing depicts a scene inside a room where several figures are seated and appear to be engaged in a music-related activity, indicated by musical instruments visible within the composition. The overall setting appears to be an interior space characterized by arches and what looks like a music stand. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome palette with soft, shadowy textures and subtle details that give depth to the room's architecture. The use of shading and the arrangement of figures suggest a moment captured during a music session or rehearsal, with an emphasis on mood and atmosphere rather than precise detail.

artworks.title: Small Lake (Le petit lac)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with tall, slender trees dominating the composition. The trees have vertical trunks and delicate branches, with a suggestion of gently sloping hills beyond them. Detailed brushstrokes create texture and depth, with a monochromatic palette of soft shades of grey and sepia. In the distance, foliage and terrain are softly etched in the background.

artworks.title: Travelers Resting (Les voyageurs fatigues)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch from a slightly elevated viewpoint, showcasing a serene scene where two figures are resting against an incline. There is no defined horizon, with the focus on the immediate landscape and individuals. The sketch features flowing brushstrokes defining the shapes of the figures and the natural environment around them, such as a large tree on the right and foliage. The color palette is monochrome in shades of brown on paper, with dark ink lines emphasizing the figures and textures in the scene.

artworks.title: Farm with Large Tree (La ferme au grand arbre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a house by a small body of water, situated on a grassy slope. The horizon is low, running behind the house. A tree on the right side of the scene adds depth and frames the view. The artist uses fine lines to create texture in the foliage and water. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of black and grey on a cream background.

artworks.title: Finding the Sheep (Le mouton retrouve)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a person tending to a sheep. The landscape includes trees, a stone wall, and a horizon line in the background. The etching uses fine lines for texture and has a color palette of primarily brown and beige. Trees, a stone wall, and a wooden ladder or fence are visible in the scene, creating a calm and serene composition.

artworks.title: Jules Dalou, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man's head and upper shoulder in profile. The man faces to the right, showing his facial features, beard, and clothing. His hair is curly and short, and he wears a plain garment. There are no visible accessories. The background has horizontal lines for texture. The etching is signed "A. Legros" at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Stroll of the Convalescent (La promenade du convalescent)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with two figures interacting. The foreground depicts two figures differing in attire, surrounded by trees. The trees are drawn with bold strokes, contrasting with the finer lines used for the figures and vegetation. In the background, more trees are faintly sketched, adding depth to the landscape. The monochromatic color palette uses sepia tones to create a detailed, textured scene. The technique combines fine linework and shading to emphasize the natural elements and figures.

artworks.title: Alphonse Legros
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams

artworks.title: Alphonse Legros
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up, with his body angled slightly to the left and his gaze directed toward the viewer. He has facial hair and curly hair, wearing a jacket over a shirt. His right hand is resting on a surface with the fingers gently curled. The background features a doorway on the left leading to a dark interior space, with the rest of the surroundings plain and lightly textured.

artworks.title: Gust of Wind (Le coup de vent)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills in the distance, some with shrubs or trees on top. The trees and foliage are intricately detailed with dense, textured brushstrokes, resembling a woodcut or etching style. The sky is depicted with lighter, sparse lines, possibly indicating a cloudy atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly black and sepia. There is a path leading through the landscape, inviting the viewer's eye to follow it into the scene.

artworks.title: Black Cat (Le chat noir)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: There are four individuals gathered around a lit candle. One person is holding the candle, and the others appear to be closely observing something outside the frame. The central figure wears a hat and a beard, while the others have different hairstyles. Their facial features are lightly defined. They wear casual clothing. Another individual is on the right, leaning against a door with a small animal on their shoulder. The background consists of cross-hatch lines.

artworks.title: Shadow (Ombre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows seven individuals seated around a rectangular table. Most of them are engaged in expressive postures, with one person raising an arm in a dramatic gesture. The individuals are wearing loose, flowing clothing. The table is adorned with plates, goblet-like vessels, and candlestick holders. The background features a shadowy figure standing behind the scene, projected onto a plain wall.

artworks.title: Supper of the Poor (Le souper chez misere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a room, primarily focusing on their upper bodies as they gather around a table. Three of the individuals are seated, while one is leaning over the table, seemingly standing. Their facial expressions appear concentrated, with distinct features highlighted by the candlelight at the center of the table. Most of the individuals have short to medium-length hair, with one person wearing a headscarf. Their clothing appears simple and modest, suitable for a domestic setting. The table in front of them is plain, with a single lit candle casting light across the scene, and it is set with a few basic items. No jewelry is visible. The background reveals a rustic, wooden interior with visible beams and a rough-textured wall.

artworks.title: Angler (Le pecheur a la ligne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person sitting on a riverbank. The drawing features delicate lines depicting a figure with their back turned holding a fishing rod, a wicker basket nearby. The river in the background is illustrated with a few lines suggesting ripples, with three trees dominating the horizon in the distance. The sketch is done in a monochromatic palette, creating a serene visual.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 3rd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body, from the chest upwards. The man is slightly angled to the right but looks directly ahead, engaging with the viewer. His facial features include a thick beard and mustache, with eyes deeply set below a furrowed brow. His hair is short, wavy, and receding slightly at the temples. The man is dressed in a simple shirt with visible buttons at the upper chest, a modest collar that sits low and open. The background is plain with minimal lines indicating a corner of a room or a backdrop, emphasizing the detailed portrayal of the subject. There is a signature at the bottom right corner of the drawing.

artworks.title: Donkey Upset by Storm (L'ane renverse par la foudre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and woman struggling against a strong wind beneath a tree. The woman is wearing a billowing garment, while the man is holding onto his hat. Beside them, a tired donkey lies on the ground with a sack on its back. The horizon is not clearly defined, merging with the cross-hatched texture of the etching. The sky above is dark and dramatic, hinting at an impending storm, contrasting with the lighter tones of the ground and figures. The play of light and shadow creates a vivid atmosphere in the monochromatic image.

artworks.title: Thunder (Un coup de foudre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in motion, bending slightly forward and holding onto a tree or bush with both hands. Her facial features are not clearly detailed due to the sketch style. Her head is turned, with the expression obscured. She has dark, textured hair styled in a bun or another form. She wears a long dress reaching her ankles that flows as she moves. There is no visible jewelry or objects she holds aside from the tree or foliage. The background features a wooded area with large trees and abundant foliage. The art style includes intricate crosshatching for depth and shadow, suggesting a dense environment.

artworks.title: In the Forest of Fontainebleau  (Dans la foret de Fontainebleau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch-like scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, depicting a landscape dominated by a line of trees. The horizon is low in the image, just above a rising slope, with tall trees extending towards the sky. The trees and foliage are characterized by brushstrokes and crosshatching technique, conveying texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark and light tones for a serene, natural quality. Line and shadow add movement and highlight the beauty of the trees as they recede into the distance, merging with the sky.

artworks.title: Drinking Trough, 2nd plate (L'abreuvoir)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene with a slightly elevated point of view. In the foreground, a seated figure wearing a hat is partially obscured by a horse standing beside them. The horse's contours are delicately rendered, curving towards the right. A thatched-roof building fills the center and right of the image, with a window letting in light. The artwork features dense, cross-hatched lines for texture and shadow, creating a monochromatic palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: Women of Brussels (Femmes de Bruges)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures sitting closely in a line. They are all shown from head to foot, with their heads slightly lowered and facing to the right. Their facial features are obscured by the hoods of their robes. Each figure wears a long robe with a hood covering most of their hair and framing their face. Their hands are visible, with some figures gesturing subtly. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Hector Berlioz
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly man. He is shown from the waist up, facing the viewer with a calm expression. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes, a strong nose, and a furrowed brow. His hair is wavy and mostly white or grey. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a suit jacket, a shirt, and a tie or cravat. The background is plain, and the artwork is attributed to "A. Legros" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Edge of a Forest in Bourgogne (Un coin de foret en Bourgogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a figure pushing a wheelbarrow filled with logs. Trees are depicted to the left of the figure, and the horizon blends into a sky filled with swirling cloud-like etchings. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette and expressive strokes to convey movement and texture.

artworks.title: Rectory Wall (Le mur du presbytere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a slightly elevated perspective. There are trees, a structure resembling a ruined tower or castle, and a rustic house with a sloped roof in the mid-distance. The brushwork is fine and detailed, resembling etching. The palette is monochromatic with dark lines on a light background. A figure in simple garments is kneeling on a path near yoked oxen. The path leads into the distance, showing a mix of human and natural elements.

artworks.title: Along the River (Le long de la rive)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a low horizon line, a lone figure sitting under a group of trees, and a sky above. The trees are detailed with fine, textured strokes and frame the left and central parts of the composition. The etching style uses flowing lines for the foliage and ground. The color scheme is monochromatic in soft sepia and cream, creating a serene atmosphere. In the distance, there are faint landscape features, emphasizing the interaction between the natural elements and the figure.
